from datetime import datetime

# Retrieve cached hotel results
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Retrieve cached attraction results
cached_attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter hotels to include only those with gym and free wifi
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=cached_hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in St. Louis
restaurants_results = search_restaurants(
    city="St. Louis"
)

# Save the restaurant search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants_results)

# Search for attractions in St. Louis with type Cultural
attractions_results = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Cultural"]
)

# Save the attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions_results", value=attractions_results)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=restaurants_results,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_restaurants", value=nearest_results)

# Find the nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_attractions", value=nearest_attractions_results)
